VBO:0200384.summary: Friendly and often easygoing at home, coonhounds retain a strong urge to follow scent. Their hunting tradition centres on trailing game through woodland, then baying beneath the tree where it takes refuge until the hunter arrives. Seven breeds belong to this American family, with personalities and hunting styles that vary across its members.
VBO:0200384.shortDescription: A scent-led family of American hounds, coonhounds pair treeing and baying instincts with an often easygoing manner at home.
